text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for summer camp again.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa! Are you really making a

comeback?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Cup, you'll be facing off
against
Nakayama Festa, the winner of
the recent
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sí! It's just as you say!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And I'm afraid I'm now outta time! Chao!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
But wow, she's in good shape. Did you
see how
quickly she dashed off?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She must be really serious if she doesn't
even
have time to answer our questions.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: Can you still run? If you can, ten more sets!
Can you still run? If you're up for it, ten more sets!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While preparing for the decisive race,
the spirits
of the Umamusume burn
hotter than the summer
heat.
